title: Bott Conjecture: nonnegatively curved simply connected manifolds are rationally elliptic
exact_target: Must the based loop space of every compact simply connected nonnegatively curved manifold have polynomially bounded Betti numbers over every coefficient field?

sources.citation: W. Ziller, Examples of Riemannian Manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature, arXiv:math/0701389v3 [math.DG], 2007.
